name: eli5
description: Create picture-led HTML explanations at a selected grade level, from 5th grade through graduate depth. Use $eli5 with a topic and optional level.

interface.longDescription: ELI5 turns a topic into a picture-led HTML artifact calibrated to 5th, middle, high, college, or graduate level, with large visuals and concise labels at every depth.
defaultPrompt: Use $eli5 to explain how DNS works at the default 5th-grade level.
Use $eli5 --level college to create a picture-led HTML explanation of this topic.
